notes: needs_ruling: the report is a narrated encounter: Ibn Umar acts («فذهب ابن عمر») and a man («إنسان») tells him that Rafi' b. Khadij reported the ban; Rafi' is named inside the story and is not read as a link here (rule 6, rule 11)
«- أو قال عبد الله بن عمر -» names another transmitter at the same level: a variant remark, not a route
